entities.name: Amenakhte
entities.description: Amonkheti human who fell during the Final Hours trying to protect a child.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Warriors whose blades struck down Amenakhte and the child.

entities.name: Hour of Eternity
entities.description: Final Hour during which Amenakhte died.

events.summary: Wounded Amenakhte begs a woman to save the child he protected; she promises, though the child is dead.
events.quote: Overcome with sympathy, she promised to save the child, even though she could not.
Amenakhte's vision faded, and he succumbed to his injuries, knowing he had done everything to protect the child.
